title: After Almost 2 Years, Our Demo Is Finally Here!
author: AlvinhoGames_
selftext:
Me and 2 other friends have been working for the past 1 year and 8 months on **Red Nox,** a Horror Roguelike Deckbuilder with Uncanny Valley Aesthetic.

The game was not totally made with AI, for the graphics we used a bunch of different AI tools + a lot of photoshop manipulation to achive these results. But i think its still a good showcase of what you can do with AI tools if you add other softwares in the mix as well

  
The Demo is already available on Steam, **it would really help us if you guys could wishlist it! (The Steam Page L1nk is on the comments!)**

replies.author: AlvinhoGames_
replies.body: Thank you! glad you liked it :)
